== Printed face and comparison ==
The Japanese face is the unchanged embedded image from the preserved collecting encyclopedia, p. 45, xref 2077. The original is [[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Chewie-Encyclopedia32-p45.jpeg]]. Japanese line breaks were joined and the printed distinction between 配備 and 配置 was retained. The translation is an English reading aid and the comparison uses the original English face. The set checklist and the family navigator retain the established edition and printing IDs. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 8 November 2026 (UTC)
